recentItems.title: పురపోరుకు భారీ భద్రత.. 36,351 మంది పోలీసులతో బందోబస్తు || ఐజీ రాజకుమారి
recentItems.description:
Andhra Pradesh Police have made elaborate security arrangements for the urban local body elections. Law and Order IG Rajakumari announced that 36,351 security personnel have been deployed across the state. Reserve teams and Quick Response Teams are on standby under the supervision of SPs and Additional SPs. Route mobiles have been used to transport ballot boxes, while additional forces will be deployed in areas witnessing violent incidents.

recentItems.title: జగన్ కేసుల్లో మరో కీలక పరిణామం | భారతీ సిమెంట్స్ కేసులో విచారణ ప్రారంభం
recentItems.description:
Hearings in the disproportionate assets cases involving YS Jagan Mohan Reddy are progressing at the CBI Court. The court has completed hearings on 45 discharge petitions across six chargesheets and has now begun proceedings in the Bharati Cements case. Jagan and other accused have filed a total of 141 discharge petitions in the CBI and ED cases. Daily hearings are underway on the chargesheets filed by both agencies. The cases have remained at the discharge petition stage for nearly 14 years, according to the information provided.
